tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page, list, inspector header and control background. The UI is white; depth comes from hairlines, not grey fills.

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: Bars that frame content: status bar, dropdown footers, settings-group heads, comment snippets.

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: Inspector body and admin side-nav, half a step off `surface`.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover on rows, side-nav links, and ghost and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: hover-subtle
tokens.usage: Hover on items that sit on `subtle` (status-bar segments).

tokens.name: checked
tokens.usage: Rows ticked for a bulk action.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Neutral chip, pill, marker and count fills; meter tracks; step numbers.

tokens.name: draft
tokens.usage: Inline editors that sit in the page: the line-filter bar and new-space rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel edges, section rules, dividers inside cards.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Control borders (buttons, inputs, selects, segmented controls), kbd outlines, menus. 1.5:1 on `surface`, under the 3:1 WCAG asks of control borders; kept from the mockups and flagged.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `surface`, `subtle`, `inset`, `hover` and `accent-soft`.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, form labels, facets, comment bodies. 7.6:1 on `surface`, 6.6:1 on `chip`.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Metadata: times, IDs, sizes, counts, placeholders, idle icons. 4.0:1 on `surface`, 3.8:1 on `subtle`, 3.5:1 on `chip`: under 4.5:1 for its 11.5–12.5px uses. Flagged; #776e76 passes on `surface` and `subtle`.

tokens.name: ink-4
tokens.usage: Code gutter line numbers and idle status dots. Decorative only: 2.1:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Aubergine, the brand. Navbar fill, primary buttons, the selected row's edge, active underlines, links and accent text on `surface` (9.4:1) and `accent-soft` (7.9:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, pressed buttons and segments, filter chips, active option card and side-nav link. `accent` or `ink` text on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent`, `danger` and `night` fills.

tokens.name: chart-bar
tokens.usage: Past bars in admin charts; the latest bar is `accent`.

tokens.name: nav-ink-2
tokens.usage: Inactive nav links and the search placeholder on the navbar (5.9:1 on `accent`). The active link is `on-accent`.

tokens.name: nav-fill
tokens.usage: Search field, scope chip and avatar fill on the navbar.

tokens.name: nav-line
tokens.usage: kbd outlines on the navbar.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Dark floating surfaces: toasts, the line-selection chip, CLI snippets.

tokens.name: night-ink
tokens.usage: CLI text on `night`.

tokens.name: night-accent
tokens.usage: Accent on `night`: the toast action (Open, Undo) and the CLI prompt. 7.3:1.

tokens.name: night-green
tokens.usage: Success on `night`: the toast check, CLI flags.

tokens.name: night-amber
tokens.usage: Quoted strings in CLI snippets on `night`.

tokens.name: type-code
tokens.usage: Code (py, js, sh, sql, yaml): row type label, badge, tile. 5.9:1 on `surface`. The eight type colours also label spaces and avatars.

tokens.name: type-text
tokens.usage: Plain text and logs (txt, log). 5.4:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: type-doc
tokens.usage: Documents (md, pdf). 5.2:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: type-data
tokens.usage: Data (json, csv, xlsx). 4.3:1 on `surface`: under 4.5:1 for the 11.5px type label; flagged.

tokens.name: type-archive
tokens.usage: Archives (zip, gz, tar). 3.6:1 on `surface`: under 4.5:1; flagged.

tokens.name: type-image
tokens.usage: Images (png, jpg, svg). 4.9:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: type-web
tokens.usage: Web (html). 3.7:1 on `surface`: under 4.5:1; flagged.

tokens.name: type-binary
tokens.usage: Binaries and disk images (iso, bin). 5.3:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive: delete buttons and menu items, the danger fill (with `on-accent`, 6.6:1), error log level, alert counts.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Inline confirmation, maintenance banner, error log level background.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Border of the inline confirmation and the maintenance banner.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `danger-soft` (9.3:1).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning dots, a usage meter near its quota, the bookmarked star's outline. 2.95:1 on `surface`, just under 3:1 for a meaningful mark; flagged.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Password and expiry markers, changed-setting tags, the key-backup banner, warning log level.

tokens.name: warning-line
tokens.usage: Border of the key-backup banner.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `warning-soft` (5.2:1); selected line numbers in code.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Fill of the bookmarked star.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Healthy dots and completed steps (3.5:1 on `surface`).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: The detected-type tag in editors.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `success-soft` (5.8:1).

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Read-only banner and info log level.

tokens.name: info-line
tokens.usage: Border of the read-only banner.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `info-soft` (6.9:1).

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Search-match highlight behind `ink` text.

tokens.name: hit-line
tokens.usage: A code or log line that matches the line filter.

tokens.name: line-selected
tokens.usage: Code lines selected for a comment or a link.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Default code text on `surface`.

tokens.name: code-line-hl
tokens.usage: The line a comment or a link points at.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords; JSON keys in the tree view. 8.1:1.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Strings. 5.4:1.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Comments, in italic. 3.8:1 on `surface`: under 4.5:1; flagged.

tokens.name: code-function
tokens.usage: Function and method names. 6.4:1.

tokens.name: code-type
tokens.usage: Types and classes; JSON booleans. 5.7:1.

tokens.name: code-number
tokens.usage: Numbers and constants. 6.5:1.

tokens.name: code-variable
tokens.usage: Variables and parameters. 6.1:1.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Ubuntu at 400 for text, 500 for names, titles and buttons, 700 for the wordmark. The family has no semibold: the mockups' 600 (labels, card heads) renders as Bold.

styles.name: text-stat
styles.usage: Big numbers on admin tiles, with tabular figures.

styles.name: text-title
styles.usage: The relic's name at the top of the inspector.

styles.name: text-wordmark
styles.usage: The word Relic beside the mark, in the navbar only.

styles.name: text-heading
styles.usage: Page-bar title and inspector mode titles (Edit details, Upload 3 files).

styles.name: text-body
styles.usage: The base size: row names, form values, toasts, menu items.

styles.name: text-body-medium
styles.usage: Buttons, nav links, the active facet, a selected row's name.

styles.name: text-small
styles.sample: sort newest · group day · rows compact
styles.usage: Page-bar facets and options, key–value lists, descriptions, small buttons.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Form field labels and card headings.

styles.name: text-micro
styles.usage: Help text, key-hint footers, chips, option descriptions.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Ubuntu Mono carries everything machine-shaped: IDs, times, sizes, types, filters, keys and code.

styles.name: mono-meta
styles.usage: Times, IDs, sizes, views and #tags in rows; counts and filter chips.

styles.name: mono-code
styles.sample: def handle_item(item: dict, *, strict: bool = False):
styles.usage: The code viewer and editor, 20px lines.

styles.name: mono-type
styles.usage: The file type in a row, in its type colour.

styles.name: mono-section
styles.usage: Section labels set in capitals (text-transform: uppercase): inspector sections, day headers, the admin nav heading.

spacing.note: Tailwind's scale, so each step maps to a utility (space-1.5 = gap-1.5 = 6px). The mockups live on 6, 10, 14 and 16px.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Between icon buttons in a row's hover actions.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in chips and small buttons; between floating-toolbar buttons.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Button icon gap; between buttons in an action row; label to control.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside inputs and options; between related controls.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Row column gap; section padding top; status-bar segment padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between form fields; inspector action row margin.

tokens.name: space-3.5
tokens.usage: Inspector header top padding; toast and card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter: rows, page bar, inspector sections.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Navbar left padding.

radius.note: Small and square-ish. The mockups also use 5, 7 and 9px; each folds into the step below (5→4, 7→6, 9→8).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, markers, kbd, filter chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented controls, the navbar search, side-nav links.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, option cards, comment threads, the inline confirmation, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The search dropdown and other popovers.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, choice pills, avatars, count bubbles, toggles.

shadow.note: Hairlines separate; shadows are only for things that float over content.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The floating toolbar when the inspector is hidden.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: The search dropdown and other popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts and the line-selection chip.

tokens.name: shadow-knob
tokens.usage: The toggle knob.

tokens.name: ring-accent
tokens.usage: Halo around a focused field or the active comment thread, beside an `accent` border.

tokens.name: ring-nav
tokens.usage: Halo around the focused navbar search.
